answer: Every key burns a 1,170,000 POA entry fee, enforced by the protocol and bound to the key, so n keys cost 1,170,000 x n. Keys under 26 epochs old also share one pool of 450,000 POA per epoch, 11.7 million over 26 epochs however many they are, so a farm of n above 10 nets at most 11,700,000 minus 1,170,000 x n, negative from n = 11. A vertex of rented wallets, a mesa of fresh keys or an oasis of idle accounts cannot lift the pool, unless it pays the fee for every key. Honest newcomers recover the fee from the pool when few.
